title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.6 - Achievements & Account Playtime
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.16.6 - Achievements & Account Playtime

- Reworked game-detail achievements into a compact progress overview with four featured goals instead of an endlessly long list.
- Browse all 102 achievements in a dedicated scrollable dialog with search and filters for unlocked and locked challenges.
- Display account playtime as the sole game-detail playtime; never display or fall back to a separate local counter.
- Keep new play sessions accurately attributed to the signed-in account with retry-safe per-installation synchronization.
- Preserve launcher-owned bottom-right achievement notifications, existing in-game achievement lists, game saves and cloud account progress.
